A '''separation test''' is a [[statistics|statistical]] procedure for early-phase research, to decide whether to pursue further research. It is designed to avoid the prevalent situation in early-phase research, when a statistically [[statistical power|underpowered]] test gives a negative result.

==Readings==
* Aickin M. (2004) "Separation Tests for Early-Phase Complementary and Alternative Medicine Comparative Trials". Evidence-Based Integrative Medicine, 1(4), 225&ndash;231
